description: This file implements a media server with Express, providing routes to serve media files with validation, MIME detection, and cleanup logic. It also includes server startup and periodic cleanup functions.

methods.name: attachMediaRoutes
methods.description: Sets up Express routes for media file retrieval with validation, MIME detection, and cleanup.

methods.name: startMediaServer
methods.description: Initializes and starts the media server on a specified port with cleanup and error handling.
